# Lab 13.7: Remote Models: Gemini, Claude & Open Models

## What We Are Going to Do
Create remote models over Gemini and a partner model (Anthropic Claude), and call them with AI.GENERATE_TEXT and model parameters.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Gemini with model parameters.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT title, result
FROM AI.GENERATE_TEXT(
  MODEL lab13.gemini,
  (SELECT title, CONCAT('Write a catchy 8-word tagline for this movie review: ', review) AS prompt
   FROM lab13.reviews LIMIT 5),
  STRUCT(0.9 AS temperature, 40 AS max_output_tokens)
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Run it again with `0.0 AS temperature`. Low temperature gives more predictable answers.

2. **[Console] Enable a Claude model.** Open **Vertex AI → Model Garden**, search for **Claude**, open a model and click **Enable**. Note the model ID and the region where it is available.

3. **[SQL] Create a Claude remote model.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT` and `CLAUDE_MODEL_ID`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL lab13.claude
REMOTE WITH CONNECTION `YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn`
OPTIONS (endpoint = 'CLAUDE_MODEL_ID');

SELECT result
FROM AI.GENERATE_TEXT(
  MODEL lab13.claude,
  (SELECT 'Explain partitioning in BigQuery to a 10-year-old in 3 sentences.' AS prompt),
  STRUCT(200 AS max_output_tokens)
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Open models.** You can deploy an open model (for example Gemma) from Model Garden to a Vertex AI endpoint, then point a remote model at that endpoint URL. Endpoints are billed per hour, so undeploy them after testing.

5. **[CLI] List the models.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

bq show --model lab13.gemini</span>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Remote model | Pointer to a Vertex AI model |
| Parameters | `temperature`, `max_output_tokens`, `top_p` |
| Partner models | Claude, Mistral, Llama after enabling |
| Open models | Your own endpoint, billed hourly |
